suites.name: actual PostgreSQL archives and restricted workload role

nativeProof: The restricted application role cannot dump the protected table
The explicit administrative backup reader produces a complete archive through the signed owner
pg_restore parses the complete archive and preserved rows are present
The workload still lacks SELECT after the backup
No MCP schema migration or audit-role bootstrap is performed by backup
limitations: Disposable hosted PostgreSQL proof is not VPS acceptance
The plan compiler is explicit opt-in and is not called by an existing launcher
No updated runtime capsule or successor delivery launcher is released
The actual Registry and worker checkpoint must be collected before defining successor adoption
The failed backup claim and all old artifacts remain unchanged
The proposed target administrative role still requires read-only preflight
